title: Second variation of a stationary submanifold along normal deformations (Simon 5.11, C³ correction)
statement: Assume (TH), FirstVariation and SecondVariation (the two conjuncts proved by the sibling root.variation_formulas-a1). (TH) is the frozen statement of the sibling root.submanifold_tangent-a1, taken as an explicit hypothesis: (TH1) for every Simon local representation (V, W, ψ) of class r ≥ 1 of any M ⊆ ℝᴺ, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = range Dψ(x) for x ∈ V; (TH2) every n-dimensional C^r Simon submanifold of ℝᴺ is a measurable set on which y ↦ tangentProjection M y is continuous. Then SecondVariationStationary holds: if M ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} is an n-dimensional C² Simon submanifold, U open with (closure M ∖ M) ∩ U = ∅, M stationary in U, and φ admissible of class 3 for (U, K) with initial velocity X normal to M (⟨X(y), v⟩ = 0 for y ∈ M, v ∈ T_yM), then t ↦ (μHE[n](φ_t(M ∩ K))).toReal (deformedArea n M K φ) is differentiable near 0 and its derivative has derivative ∫_M (Σ_i |(D_{τ_i}X)^⊥|² − Σ_{i,j} (X · B(τ_i, τ_j))²) dμHE[n] (stableSecondVariationIntegrand) at 0.
lean_statement: ((∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), 1 ≤ r → Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) ∧ ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) r M → MeasurableSet M ∧ ContinuousOn (tangentProjection M) M) → FirstVariation → SecondVariation → SecondVariationStationary
